_comment: §15.4 — a controlled benchmark that asks whether a suite would CATCH a defect, not whether it looks similar to a reference. Each defect names the observable symptom a test must assert to detect it. A suite that merely mentions the feature earns no credit; only an assertion that would differ between the correct and defective versions counts.

ticket.summary: Invoice management: permissions, upload limits and ordering
ticket.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- An owner can delete an invoice
- A viewer cannot delete an invoice
- Uploads up to and including 100 KB are accepted
- Uploads above 100 KB are rejected with a size error
- Invoices are listed newest first
- Submitting the form twice must create only one invoice
- A draft invoice becomes 'issued' when submitted, and cannot return to draft

defects.description: The role check is inverted: viewers can delete, owners cannot.
The limit check uses > 99 KB instead of > 100 KB, so a 100 KB upload is wrongly rejected.
The invoice is shown as created but never written to the database; it disappears on reload.

detectedBy.mustAssert: newest first|most recent|descending|top of the list

defects.description: Double-submitting the form creates two invoices.
An issued invoice can be moved back to draft.

generatedSuite.title: Owner deletes an invoice
generatedSuite.preconditions: Logged in as an owner; an invoice exists
generatedSuite.expected_result: The invoice is deleted and no longer appears in the list

generatedSuite.title: Viewer cannot delete an invoice
generatedSuite.preconditions: Logged in as a viewer; an invoice exists
generatedSuite.expected_result: Deletion is denied and the invoice remains in the list

generatedSuite.title: Upload at the 100 KB limit is accepted
steps: Upload a file of exactly 100 KB
generatedSuite.expected_result: The upload is accepted and the file appears in the attachment list

generatedSuite.title: Upload above the 100 KB limit is rejected
generatedSuite.expected_result: The upload is rejected with a size error

generatedSuite.title: A created invoice persists across a reload
generatedSuite.expected_result: The invoice is still present after the reload

generatedSuite.title: Invoices are listed newest first
generatedSuite.preconditions: At least two invoices exist with different creation dates
steps: Compare the order of the first two rows
generatedSuite.expected_result: The most recently created invoice appears at the top of the list

generatedSuite.title: Submitting the form twice creates only one invoice
generatedSuite.preconditions: Logged in as an owner; the invoice form is filled in
steps: Click Submit again before the page updates

generatedSuite.title: An issued invoice cannot return to draft
generatedSuite.preconditions: An invoice is in the 'issued' state
steps: Attempt to set its status back to draft
generatedSuite.expected_result: The change is rejected and the invoice remains issued
